gameplay.text: Goal: stay Front-Lane and CC any heroes/units on cooldown, while being able to sidestep through units at any time to chase a hero or exotic units (enabled by the phantom trait).
The class stacks rage through getting hit while in defensive state (right-click) and through hitting the enemy; this charges and stacks up to 4 ultimates (5s CD).
Spear throw and mounted spear throw do not share the same cooldown — use them independently/wisely.
Shift-AA is used to smother combos ("Make use of shift-aa to smother combo").
Has a phantom trait allowing phasing through units (used to sidestep through units while chasing heroes/exotics).
